verdict.rationale: Notte's own materials document natural-language task execution. The GitHub README says it gives 'AI agents natural language tasks to complete on websites', and the site promises 'Describe a task. Watch it happen. One prompt. No selectors'. There is also an agent-start API for running web agents on your behalf, and a documented multi-step example: 'Go to linkedin.com, login with the credentials and extract the last 10 messages'. One community user reported a failed extraction on hyatt.com, which lowers confidence but is a single anecdote rather than a systematic contradiction. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of form-filling and click-through flow handling, and independent hands-on corroboration of successful end-to-end multi-step runs.
